Zomato Lays Off 250 Employees, Closes Hyderabad Customer Support Center

Food delivery company Zomato has laid off approximately 250 employees and closed its customer support center in Hyderabad. This decision comes as part of a restructuring of its customer support operations. The company has not provided further details on the restructuring or the reasons behind the layoffs beyond operational changes.
